description: Current headline readings (value, unit, observation date) for the site's charts: S&P 500 level, Shiller CAPE, forward P/E for the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, SOX and sector ETFs, VIX, drawdown from the high, breadth, Magnificent 7 weight and more. Pass `id` for one chart, or omit it for all.

id.description: Chart id, e.g. "pe" (Shiller CAPE), "forward-pe", "ndx-forward-pe", "drawdown", "vix". Omit for every reading.

name: get_latest
title: Latest readings
